source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of AC through a capacitor (PDF 96-98).

blocks.text: Capacitor plates ke darmiyan insulating medium ki wajah se direct current guzarne nahi deta, lekin alternating current is se guzar sakta hai. Capacitor reactive hissa hai: resistor ke bar-aks yeh tawanai apne electric field mein jama karta hai. Jab capacitor C par alternating voltage V lagaya jaye (Fig 17.8 a) to voltage ulatne ke saath yeh pehle aik taraf phir doosri taraf charge hota hai; electrons circuit mein aage peeche chalte hain, yahi alternating current hai.

Kisi lamhe capacitor par charge q = CV hai. V = Vo sin(wt) (17.18) ke saath q = C Vo sin(wt), aur current I = dq/dt = C Vo w cos(wt) = w C Vo sin(wt + pi/2). Io = w C Vo likhne par I = Io sin(wt + pi/2) (17.19). Yun capacitor mein current voltage se 90 darje (pi/2 rad) aage hai; voltage current se peeche hai (Figs 17.8 b aur c).

blocks.alt: (a) AC voltage source V ke saath loop mein capacitor C (voltage VC). (b) Current I (surkh, nuqte P, N, R, S, T), voltage V (purple, nuqte A, B, C, D, E) aur charge q (dashed) waqt ke saath; current voltage se chauthai chakkar pehle chotti par. (c) VC hawala lakeer par aur IC us se 90 darje aage, w par anticlockwise.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.8: (a) AC voltage source se jura capacitor; (b) capacitor ke current aur voltage ka graph; (c) capacitor ke current aur voltage ke vectors (kitab ki Figure 17.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Graph mein P par current zyada se zyada hai jab voltage aur charge sifar hain: khali capacitor sab se tez charge hota hai. A par voltage chotti par hai aur current (N) sifar. Is liye capacitor mein current voltage se 90 darje aage hai, inductor ke bar-aks.

blocks.title: Capacitor, inductor nahi
blocks.text: Kitab equation 17.19 ke baad kehti hai 'inductor ka current voltage se 90 darje aage', aur XC ki ta'reef 'inductor mein voltage' ka zikr karti hai. Dono capacitor ke bare mein hain: capacitor mein current aage; inductor mein peeche.

blocks.title: Capacitive reactance
blocks.text: Capacitor ki mukhalfat us ki capacitive reactance hai, XC = Vrms / Irms = Vo / Io. Kyunke Io = w C Vo, XC = 1/(wC) = 1/(2 pi f C), jahan w = 2 pi f. Is ki ikai ohm hai.
Kam frequencies par capacitor ki reactance bari aur current chhota hota hai; zyada frequencies par us ki reactance chhoti aur usi capacitor se current bara hota hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Nikola Tesla, jinhein alternating currents ka baap kaha jata hai, 1856 mein Austria-Hungary mein paida hue aur 1884 mein USA chale gaye. Unhon ne alternating current ki paidawar, tarseel aur istemal ki bunyaad rakhi, jo direct current se kaheen zyada faaslon tak bheja ja sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: 10 uF capacitor ki reactance 50 Hz aur 5 kHz par maloom karein.
blocks.explanation: 50 Hz par: XC = 1/(2 x 3.14 x 50 x 10 x 10^-6) = 318 ohm. 5 kHz par: 3.18 ohm, sau guna kam.

items: Capacitor: I, V se 90 darje aage.
XC = 1/wC = 1/(2 pi f C): DC ke liye la-mehdood, zyada f par chhoti.
